title: Digital Fly Lab video record (published 2026-09-28; optional language field added 2026-10-05)

video_id.description: Stable slug, never reused. Also the gallery card anchor #v-<video_id>.

title.description: Title or first line of the post, as published.

display_title.description: Card heading: the published title, shortened when it is a long caption, without our annotations.

title_note.description: Why display_title differs from title, or what kind of post it is.

url.description: Canonical https page of the video on its platform.

file_url.description: Direct MP4 file for project-hosted videos (link only; not re-hosted).

upload_status.description: original = project author, lab or institution; repost = copy or re-edit of original_of; commentary = third-party explainer (see covers).

original_of.description: video_id of the original this repost copies.

reposted_as.description: video_ids of listed reposts of this video.

uploader_note.description: Who the uploader is, in our words.

publish_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD as shown by the platform; null when the host shows none.

duration.description: Length as m:ss or h:mm:ss; null when the host does not state it (some project files). Null allowed since 2026-09-28 (run 2).

shows.description: What the video shows, in our words.

does_not_show.description: What the video does not show, from our catalogue and verdicts.

summary_basis.description: What our summary rests on. We did not watch every video frame by frame.

catalogue_id.description: Matching catalogue entry id in projects.json, or null.

evidence_grade.description: Copied from the catalogue entry; null when the video is not in the catalogue.

grade_status.description: from catalogue; not graded (dataset, body or tool); commentary; or, for videos not in the catalogue, why they are not graded.

covers.description: Catalogue entries the video discusses, with their catalogue grades (commentary videos, and control studies that test other projects).

verdict_anchor.description: Is it real? verdict row for this project, if one exists.

thumbnail_url.description: Platform thumbnail (i.ytimg.com or pbs.twimg.com) or null.

playback.description: link-only: the video plays only on its original platform.

last_checked.description: Date we checked the link and platform record.

language.description: Main spoken or written language of the video, ISO 639-1 (e.g. en, fr, es, ru). Optional; added 2026-10-05 (run 8). Judged from the title, channel and description, not from watching.
